title: GitHub: run a workflow on another ref
support_note: A GitHub write under the default windowed read-write set files a request: internal/ghbroker/window.go (the Request and its About, aboutOf) through Authority.Classify (authority.go). `gh workflow run` on the default branch runs unasked under a runs grant; with none, or on another ref, it files this request, with the workflow file as title and the ref in refs (aboutOf's dispatch branch).
story: An agent asks to run the deploy workflow of example-org/app on an experiment branch, which no runs grant covers.
